svg.aria-label: Constructed 3D block with channel, throat, side branch and isolated pore. A and B show the section at y index 20; statistics use the full 48³ volume. Green pores span both z faces. Curves compare blur standard deviations σ of 0.5, 1 and 1.5 voxels and distinguish threshold effects on volume fraction and spanning fraction.
